selected.appraisal: Design: formal contracts plus mutation experiments. Comparator: repaired gates tested with original versus fresh operators. Completion guarantees require bounded repair and protected checker state; they do not imply correct work. The selected results show post-repair corpus success can miss a fresh defect family. Shared authorship, gate-conditioned seeds, incomplete label audit and no conforming Tier-2 cases limit inference. The setup text also describes 57 of 69 loops with eleven exclusions, leaving its denominator explanation unreconciled. Treat this as an evidence gap. No proof, code or result was independently reproduced. Use as a candidate for adversarial-check design, not a reliable failure-rate estimate or permission to run more agents.

evidence.observation: Write body and commit enclosed by BEGIN IMMEDIATE; uncertain commit acknowledgment triggers fresh read inspection and CommitUncertain.
Claim compares canonical input before mutation, rejects live holders, increments generation on takeover. Holder guard checks status, owner, generation and lease expiry under write lock.
Receipt creation, checkpoint update and history append share run_immediate transaction; final completion requires full prefix and receipt.
Replay uses read-only connection and rejects nonterminal/held states and mismatching input.
Receipt job primary key and uniqueness; append-only triggers, subject to database owner control.
Test definitions inject worker death around receipt insertion; inspected only, no passing-run claim.
Test definitions cover corruption and unknown outcomes remaining held; inspected only.

limits: Local SQLite atomicity does not cover a remote API, email, payment or other external side effect.
Generation fencing is a local write guard, not authorization to act or authenticated worker identity.
Database owner can alter schema/triggers; append-only is not independent witness or signature.
Wall-clock lease assumptions and POSIX demo do not prove Windows process-death behavior or power-loss recovery.
No measured collaboration benefit, latency advantage or cost saving established.
